questions.q: Let the coefficients of three consecutive terms in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><msup><mo>)</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></msup></math> be in the ratio <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mn>5</mn><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mn>8</mn></math>. Then the coefficient of the term, which is in the middle of these three terms, is
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
Given,

The coefficients of three consecutive terms in the binomial expansion of (1+2x)n be in the ratio 2: 5: 8.

Now rth term in expansion of (1+2x)n is given by, tr+1=Crn(2x)r

Now let Tr, Tr+1, Tr+2 are in the ratio 2:5:8

⇒TrTr+1=Cr-1n(2)r-1Crn(2)r=25

⇒n!(r-1)!(n-r+1)!n!(2)r!(n-r)!=25

⇒rn-r+1=45⇒5r=4n-4r+4 

⇒9r=4(n+1) .......1

Now taking other ratio Tr+1Tr+2=Crn(2)rCr+1n(2)r+1=58

⇒n!r!(n-r)!n!(r+1)!(n-r-1)!=54⇒r+1n-r=54

⇒4r+4=5n-5r

⇒5n-4=9r .........2

From equation 1 & 2 we get,

4n+4=5n-4⇒n=8 and r=4

So, coefficient of middle term will be

C4824=16×8×7×6×54×3×2×1=16×70=1120

questions.q: If the constant term, in binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mi>r</mi></msup><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>10</mn></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>180</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi></math> is equal to ____________.
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
The general term in the binomial expansion of a+bn is CRnan-RbR.

Thus, the general term in the expansion of 2xr+1x210 is =CR102xr10-R1x2R

=CR10210-Rxr10-Rx-2R

Given, the constant term in the expansion is 180

⇒CR10·210-R=180   …1 

And (10-R)r-2R=0

⇒r=2R10-R

⇒r=2(R-10)10-R+2010-R

⇒r=-2+2010-R    …2

Since R is positive integer less than or equal to 10 and r is also an integer, hence, the value of R is such that, 10-R must divide 20.

This is possible, when the value of 10-R can be one from the divisors of 20 i.e. 10-R can be from 1, 2, 4 or 5 and consequently, R can be 9, 8, 6 or 5 respectively.

But for R=9, 6 & 5 equation 1 is  not satisfied, hence R=8

as CR10210-R=180

⇒r=2×810-8=8.
